projects.title: Meet Drake
projects.description: A full-stack LinkedIn automation platform featuring a custom Chrome extension for seamless profile extraction and a robust Next.js/MongoDB backend for managing automated outreach campaigns and centralized CRM syncing.
projects.content:
The project has two main pieces that work closely together: a custom Chrome extension that lives right in your browser, and a Next.js web dashboard that acts as the brain of the operation.
The Chrome extension is the core engine of the platform. I designed it to seamlessly layer over LinkedIn to handle the tedious, manual tasks. Its key features include:
• Automatically scraping profile details and syncing connections straight to the CRM in real-time.
• Running automated messaging campaigns and follow-up sequences.
• Handling bulk connection requests safely and efficiently.
• Interacting with profiles (like viewing pages, liking, and commenting) to keep user accounts active and boost engagement.
On the backend, I built a robust Next.js and MongoDB dashboard to organize all this incoming data. One of the biggest technical challenges I tackled was making sure we didn't save the exact same LinkedIn profile multiple times if different users connected with them. I solved this by building a centralized, shared database model—so if ten users interact with the same person, the profile data is only stored once. This kept the app lightning-fast and saved a ton on database costs. 
I also built out a rock-solid syncing system to make sure the Chrome extension and the backend CRM never trip over each other, even when hundreds of profiles are syncing at the exact same time. Overall, it was an incredibly fun project that pushed my skills in building reliable browser extensions, managing complex background scripts, and designing smart database architectures.

projects.title: Local-Key
projects.description: A location-based discount platform with QR code scanning, geolocation filtering, and multi-role dashboards for businesses and admins managing offer redemptions.
projects.content: Local-Key is a location-based discount platform that connects businesses with nearby customers. Features include QR code scanning for offer redemptions, geolocation-based filtering to discover deals, and multi-role dashboards for businesses and admins. The platform handles real-time offer management and analytics for participating businesses.

projects.title: Mister Clay
projects.description: Full-featured e-commerce platform for paint products with cart functionality, Stripe payment integration, inventory management, and responsive design.
projects.content: Mister Clay is a complete e-commerce solution for paint products. Built with the MERN stack, it features a full shopping cart system, Stripe payment integration for secure transactions, real-time inventory management, and a fully responsive design optimized for all devices.

projects.title: NOMIA Docs Chatbot
projects.description: Dual-agent chatbot system combining RAG and SQL agents using Langchain, enabling natural language queries across both structured and unstructured documents.
projects.content: Built a dual-agent chatbot system for NOMIA Docs that combines RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and SQL agents using Langchain. The system enables natural language queries across both structured databases and unstructured documents. Deployed with FastAPI, Docker containerization, and Nginx reverse proxy, achieving 99.5% uptime in production.
